title: HinTel-AlignBench: A Framework and Benchmark for Hindi–Telugu with English-Aligned Samples

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing Vision-Language Model (VLM) accuracy on aligned multi-modal question answering datasets across English, Hindi, and Telugu to quantify the performance regression from a high-resource language to low-resource Indic languages.

Evaluating model performance on the natively-sourced VAANI dataset, which features images and questions specific to Indian traditions, artifacts, and local contexts, and conducting failure analysis to categorize errors like 'Missing Indian context' and 'Failure to Ground in Indian Culture'.
